title: Dream Painting Pikachu · Fine Card cut (example)

scenes.vo: Gambar-gambar Pikachu dari 30th Celebration ternyata ada figure blind box-nya?! Dan satu di antaranya Secret.
scenes.caption: The 30th Celebration Pikachu art has a figure blind box?! And one is a Secret.
scenes.visual: Studio shot of the Sugimori figure on white, slow push-in; the hook types on top-left (sans + italic serif)

title.text: The 30th Celebration Pikachu art has a *figure blind box?!* And one is a *Secret.*

scenes.vo: September 2026, untuk ulang tahun ke-30 Pokémon, Pokémon China merilis Dream Painting.
scenes.caption: In Sept 2026, for Pokémon's 30th, Pokémon China released Dream Painting.
scenes.visual: Box on a white studio sweep with a booster pack behind it on each side, slow push-in

scenes.vo: Set kartu 30th Celebration punya 30 Pikachu, dan tiap kartunya digambar ilustrator yang berbeda.
scenes.caption: The 30th Celebration card set has 30 Pikachus, each drawn by a different artist.
scenes.visual: Fast macro cuts across three Pikachu card artworks

scenes.vo: Tiga belas di antaranya dibuat jadi figure, lengkap dengan kartu aslinya di setiap box.
scenes.caption: Thirteen became figures, each one boxed with its card.
scenes.visual: Three figures on white, one shot each with slow push

scenes.vo: Salah satunya digambar Atsuko Nishida, orang yang pertama kali mendesain Pikachu.
scenes.caption: One of them is by Atsuko Nishida, the person who first designed Pikachu.
scenes.visual: Nishida's card, camera glides into the 'Illus. Atsuko Nishida · 041/103 · 25/30' credit

scenes.vo: Di sisi box-nya, figure Secret ini cuma ditandai tanda tanya. Isinya?
scenes.caption: On the box, the Secret figure is just a question mark. What's inside?
scenes.visual: Box on white, camera drifts into the side panel's '?' Secret silhouette (隐藏款)

scenes.vo: Pikachu dari Base Set, set pertama Pokémon TCG.
scenes.caption: Pikachu from Base Set, the very first Pokémon TCG set.
scenes.visual: Card 136/103 comes into focus, then the Secret figure itself on white

scenes.vo: Ilustrasinya karya legenda Pokémon TCG, Mitsuhiro Arita…
scenes.caption: The art is by Pokémon TCG legend Mitsuhiro Arita…
scenes.visual: Arita photo over a blurred card wall, name in Japanese + romaji

scenes.vo: …yang juga menggambar Charizard Base Set yang legendaris.
scenes.caption: …who also drew the legendary Base Set Charizard.
scenes.visual: Base Set Charizard inside a film-strip frame (archival look), slow pan

scenes.vo: Rasio produksinya 143 banding 1. Artinya, rata-rata cuma ada satu figure Secret di setiap 144 box.
scenes.caption: It's made at 143 to 1: on average, one Secret figure in every 144 boxes.
scenes.visual: Split screen: card 136/103 art over the Secret figure; then the figure with a type-on '143 : 1'

scenes.vo: Mau coba keberuntunganmu? Blind box Dream Painting sudah ready di Kard Avenue.
scenes.caption: Feeling lucky? Dream Painting blind boxes are in stock at Kard Avenue.
scenes.visual: Box on white, slow push; small red 'IN STOCK · KARD AVENUE' tag

scenes.vo: Follow Kard Avenue buat update terbaru, dan download app-nya di Google Play dan App Store.
scenes.caption: Follow Kard Avenue for the latest updates, and download the app on Google Play and the App Store.
scenes.visual: Fixed full-screen FOLLOW US! end card
